quest.title: O Archon, Hear Me!
quest.description: Something seems to be bothering a boy named Shouta...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Lacquerware... how do you make those...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you need lacquerware?

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: #Oh, it's you, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}. So here's the thing. Have you ever heard of a shrine's divine intervention?

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: From what I've heard, if you give precious offerings to the shrine, maybe your wishes will come true.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: I think that pretty lacquerware is very valuable. If I used those as offerings to the shrine, then I'd be sure to get a reply.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: However, I don't have money to buy any lacquerware. That's why I want to make one for myself.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: I heard that Nanatsuki from Yayoi Lacquerware is very good at making them...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: #Could you go ask her about the lacquerware, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}?

response.speaker: Shouta
response.text: Nanatsuki is pretty serious most of the time. I don't have the guts to go ask for her help myself...

response.speaker: Shouta
response.text: #But if you're with me, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}, things will probably go better...

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: Hello, is there anything I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Uhh... so...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, he wants to ask about lacquerware...

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: Ah, so you want to offer lacquerwares to the shrine, and you want to make one yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Please, Nanatsuki. I have a wish that I want to have fulfilled! That's why I... Don't worry, I won't tell anyone about your secret formula!

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: The issue is not the painting formula. If you want to make beautiful lacquerware, leaving the paint aside, you also need a long period of practice.

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: And this isn't just about time, it's more about... the capital. I am the fourth generation successor to a family of lacquerware-makers.

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: I even traveled to Sumeru to study lacquerwares. So it's impossible for you to grasp lacquerwares overnight.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Is... is that so? But I can't really think of anything else to offer to the shrine...

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: In my opinion, it's not about the value of the item being offered to the shrine. This item you offer should represent your feelings.

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: As long as you have the right feelings and intentions, and offer your favorite items, you should be able to get a response from the archons.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Right feelings and intentions... the things that I like...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Hmm, I think I get it... and I also don't. But thank you anyway, Nanatsuki.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: #Let's go back to the shrine first, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}. I still need your help with figuring out the kind of things I want to offer.

talks.objective: Help Shouta place offerings at the shrine

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: I mean, Nanatsuki said that I should, didn't she? But what should I offer, exactly...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Speaking of things that I like, it's gotta be Tricolor Dango. I love them so much...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: But would it be disrespectful to offer Tricolor Dango? I offered Konpeito Candy before as well, but I got no reply.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: I've also heard that some people will pack fresh petals into sachets and offer those. That sounds more appropriate than Dango...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: #What should we do? What do you think we should offer, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go with Tricolor Dango.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Really? Okay! I happened to have brought one with me. My mom made it for me and I haven't even eaten it yet...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Let's offer it up, then!

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: O Archon, bless me and help my wishes come true...

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: #Thank you for staying with me until now, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}. Please have these. They're for you!

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: I'll come back here tomorrow to check again. I hope that I'll receive a reply...

talks.objective: Help Shouta place offerings at the shrine

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's better that we offer one of those sachets.

dialogues.speaker: Shouta
dialogues.text: Okay. Let's go with your idea!
